import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static long[] f = new long[181];
    static long n, ans;
    static final long MAXLL = 9000000000000000000L;

    static long Abs(long a) {
        return a < 0 ? -a : a;
    }

    static void rec(long nom, long k) {
        if (n == 0) {
            if (k < ans) {
                ans = k;
            }
            return;
        }
        if (nom == 0) {
            return;
        }
        for (long i = -10; i <= 10; i++) {
            if (n + i * f[(int)nom] > 0) {
                n += i * f[(int)nom];
                rec(nom - 1, k + Abs(i) * nom);
                n -= i * f[(int)nom];
                break;
            }
        }
        for (long i = -10; i <= 10; i++) {
            if (n + i * f[(int)nom] == 0) {
                n += i * f[(int)nom];
                rec(nom - 1, k + Abs(i) * nom);
                n -= i * f[(int)nom];
                break;
            }
        }
        for (long i = 10; i >= -10; i--) {
            if (n + i * f[(int)nom] < 0) {
                n += i * f[(int)nom];
                rec(nom - 1, k + Abs(i) * nom);
                n -= i * f[(int)nom];
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextLong();

        f[1] = 1;
        for (int i = 2; i <= 16; i++) {
            f[i] = f[i - 1] * 10 + 1;
        }

        ans = MAXLL;

        rec(16, 0);

        System.out.println(ans);
        sc.close();
    }
}
